title: Model or engine?
intro: Two optimization families: change the **model** before deployment, or run it smarter at **runtime**. Sort them.

buckets.label: Inference optimization (runtime)
buckets.hint: The engine runs an unchanged model smarter

cards.text: GPTQ calibration with a representative dataset
Prefix caching for shared system prompts

debrief: Model optimizations (quantization, sparsification, calibrated compression) shrink what must move through the memory hierarchy — applied **once, before deployment**. Inference optimizations (continuous batching, PagedAttention, prefix caching) never touch the weights — the engine schedules and allocates smarter **at runtime**. The 10× comes from stacking both.
